title: Media-Source Aggregate Mention Solr Document (v1)
description: Schema for aggregate mention documents in the 08_impresso_mentions collection for press agencies and radio stations. Each document groups accepted occurrences sharing an exact surface and media-source type.

id.description: Deterministic aggregate identifier: 'a1_' followed by the unpadded base64url encoding of the first 16 bytes of the SHA-256 digest of the compact JSON encoding of [surface, predicted type]. The identifier is based only on the exact aggregate surface and predicted type.

surface_s.description: The surface form of the aggregate entity mention. Previous field name: l_s.

ner_predicted_type_s.description: Predicted media-source type of the aggregate mention.

occurrence_count_l.description: Number of accepted occurrences in this exact surface/type aggregate, including linked and NIL occurrences.

content_item_count_l.description: Number of distinct content items containing this exact surface/type aggregate.

linked_occurrence_count_l.description: Number of occurrences in this aggregate linked to an entity QID. It may be zero for an all-NIL aggregate.

linked_content_item_count_l.description: Number of distinct content items containing at least one linked occurrence in this aggregate. It may be zero for an all-NIL aggregate.

nil_occurrence_count_l.description: Number of occurrences in this aggregate with no linked entity QID. It may be zero for an all-linked aggregate.
